_meta.description: Mizoram district & sessions court formatting rules — drives cause-title, party designations, prayer language, verification format
_meta.change_protocol: CLO sign-off required for any change. Vishal raises Jira tickets to Ajay for additions; never edits unilaterally.

designation: IN THE COURT OF DISTRICT & SESSIONS JUDGE
jurisdictionNote: District-level criminal and civil courts in Mizoram, supervised by the Gauhati High Court — Aizawl Bench. Mizoram presently has 11 districts following the 2019–2020 reorganisation. English and Mizo are working languages under the Mizoram Official Languages Act. Sixth Schedule autonomous district councils (Chakma, Lai, Mara) operate parallel customary courts.

party_designation.state: State of Mizoram through the Principal Secretary, Home Department, Government of Mizoram, Aizawl

case_nomenclature.atrocity_case: Spl. Sessions (SC/ST Atrocities) Case No. _____ of {year}

prayer_language.opening: It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to:
prayer_language.closing: And for this act of kindness, the petitioner shall, as in duty bound, ever pray.

verification_format:
I, {deponent_name}, {designation}, do hereby solemnly verify and declare that the contents of paragraphs ___ to ___ of the above petition are true to my personal knowledge and the contents of paragraphs ___ to ___ are based on information received and legal advice tendered, which I believe to be true. Nothing material has been concealed therefrom.

Verified at {place} on this {date}.

DEPONENT
localRules: English is the language of pleadings before the Gauhati High Court Aizawl Bench; Mizo pleadings with English translation are accepted at the discretion of subordinate courts.
Bail applications under S.483 BNSS (formerly S.439 CrPC) must disclose any prior rejection and be accompanied by certified copy of the FIR.
Anticipatory bail applications (S.482 BNSS) require certified copy of FIR and grounds of apprehension; Gauhati HC Aizawl Bench is the preferred forum for serious offences.
Vakalatnama in the form prescribed under the Gauhati High Court Rules with requisite court-fee stamp.
Court-fee under the Court-Fees Act, 1870 as adopted by Mizoram.
SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, POCSO and NDPS cases tried by designated Special Courts at the district headquarters.

Sixth Schedule autonomous district councils — Chakma Autonomous District Council, Lai Autonomous District Council, Mara Autonomous District Council — operate parallel village/subordinate council courts under the Mizoram (Lai Autonomous District Council) Administration of Justice Rules and analogous instruments. Lawngtlai, Saiha districts substantially fall within these council areas; advocate must verify forum jurisdiction before filing matters involving tribal customary law.
e_filing_note: e-Filing operational at Aizawl via eCourts portal; not yet mandatory state-wide.
